Never Have I Ever Prompts

A deck of 90 Never Have I Ever prompts — draw one at a time, shuffle the deck, track what's left.

Press Draw to flip the first card.

90 prompts left in the deck

📖 How to use

  1. Press Draw a Prompt to flip the next card.
  2. Read it aloud — everyone who HAS done it drinks / puts a finger down.
  3. Press Shuffle Deck anytime for a fresh order.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How many prompts are there?

90 prompts from mild to spicy — clean enough for mixed company, fun enough for parties.

Do prompts repeat?

Draw pulls the next card without repeating; Shuffle reshuffles the whole deck and resets the counter.

How do I know what's left?

The counter shows how many prompts remain in the current deck.
